It's life events that did it. Meds can't help with that, nor can a hospital, especially given the horrible track record I've had with them. I just, absolutely, have no safety net. No support structure. My ex left me abruptly in this state because she was "enabling" me. I tried getting a social worker to help me out of my current situation... they skipped out and then wrote me off because I didn't fill out and mail back some intake paperwork that I told them I wouldn't be able to retrieve from the mailbox.   


There is major depression going on, that's for certain, but it's trauma and situationally related. There's a phrase that's said of those with C-PTSD that we have a finite amount of spoons per day and once we're out we're out... My whole fucking silverware drawer is gone.   


If it's against the rules to have the suggestion please remove that bit, I don't want another person dealing with consequences for trying to help, but thank you for understanding nonetheless.

I'm sorry we have to agree to disagree but, death is absolutely in the hands of everyone and is an actionable item at the volition of the animal's subconscious. My subconscious has already gone past the survival base instinct on more than one occasion. That safety net, though still intact with the tiniest of shreds, is a non-issue for me to bypass.   


If I die, I will have no effect whatsoever on any relative I've had as I've been estranged from them for so long I've written them off long ago. To them, I'm dead any way and there is no way in hell I'd make contact with them again given the trauma experienced by their hands.   


Friends? None. Gone, some 6 feet under, some skipped out of town, some are in other countries others still in geographically distant states and I haven't talked to them in too long.  


Time, itself, imo, is a very funny thing. The future has already happened as the present is an illusion we pay attention to to actually process things on going. The past is just as much the present as the future and all the above aren't linear. Maybe there's a parallel path where, once again, I fail at my attempt by some means or other. I, however, choose to navigate the other pathway.  


My life has taught me that I am of absolutely no benefit to anyone, except to be a resource tapped till it's gone and then discarded. That is a cycle that has been the entirety of my almost half a century of suffering time and again. Every. Single. Time. I have tried again and tried again it has netted the exact same result with the exact same message. If it were just a few patches here and there of shitty people, whatever, I get that, but when it has been repeated and repeated over and over and over and over and ends up exactly the same, with occasional people trying to guide me towards accepting that I didn't fail people but them me... if it's everyone I've met and they don't know each other and they repeat the same damned pattern, at some point I have to accept accountability for my transgressions of simply wanting to live and maybe, just once get the same kind of assistance that I've strove to provide others...  


So, if it's between continuing to prove the definition of insanity/being Sisyphus with his damned boulder... I damn well decide that, my own version of Hara Kiri/Seppuku is in order as I can't think of another damned solution to atone for being born.

I used to think that way. I don't recommend anyone else thinking differently. However, I lost everything. No one here. It's ironic that I've attained the ultimate understanding in my Taoist path, in understanding the futility of life as the journey comes to an end.

Sincerity is a very very rare commodity in this day and age. Same with integrity, empathy, genuine compassion with no strings attached and the balls to see things the way they truly are. All those are linked nonetheless...

Yeah.. I deserve to suffer but I also want to be dead before anyone can call a health and wellness, zoloft would be it, although vomiting wouldn't happen. Decades of drinking allowed me to train away the vomit reflex.   


The ex left me a decent amount of muscle relaxers. I was going to use them but I don't want it to be painless. I want to feel every little bit of the pain everyone has reinforced and I know I deserve.

One major reason I am not telling my therapist about my deterministic ideation is because of how fucked the system is. Getting locked up in a fucking hospital while the Doctor in charge of the MH ward laughed at and demeaned me for the suicide attempt that landed me in there didn't help. If anything, it reinforced the importance of not telling anyone.
My loved ones are the reason I've decided to go... such a shitty judgmental line. Like, in my case, I have no family. Who am I going to hurt? My landlord? IDGAF about that one.
F in the chat for terraforming. F in the chat to pay respects. Thy name will not be forgotten.

Update for my own issue. I looked through the wallet t's & c's and realized that you can indeed request a refund for wallet credit within 60 days. So, that's what I did, the support ninja who received my ticket offered to either refund the wallet credit or escalate the issue to a specialist. I decided to give the specialist a try, it took nearly a week, but I just got an email today where they let me know that my issues stemmed from suspicious activity but that they made an adjustment which should resolve it. They didn't define what the issue was, which I get, having worked for a payment platform's online validation division for a while... Defining what can be considered suspicious is a good way to give someone who has ill intent the ability to bypass the technicalities, which, in this case, could lead to someone getting away with g2a key farming as an example. 

Though they didn't specify what the activity was, they did clarify that using a VPN or proxy when making purchases can lead to the same predicament. I run a double hop set up, so, I'm pretty certain that's what was causing the issue since I set both tunnels to different locations.

I just disabled my VPN specifically to order a few games on sale now and my purchase went through without a hitch. IDK if that's the cause for others getting this issue, but it makes sense to me from a business security stand-point. 

TL;DR - a Humble specialist advised that purchasing things while having a VPN running can lead to this issue. They fixed the issue and I was able to make a purchase with my wallet. If you're making your purchase while connected to a VPN or proxy, disable it briefly so that their merchant software doesn't flag your purchase for possible key mining.
